name: CIRCT Development Environment
postCreateCommand:
bash -c 'set -e && \
    echo "Updating package lists..." && \
    sudo apt-get update && \
    \
    echo "Installing build dependencies..." && \
    sudo apt-get install -y ninja-build python3-pip && \
    \
    echo "Initializing Git submodules (fetching LLVM)..." && \
    git submodule update --init --recursive && \
    \
    echo "Installing Python dependencies..." && \
    pip install -r frontends/PyCDE/python/requirements.txt && \
    \
    echo "Creating and configuring the CMake build directory..." && \
    cmake \
      -S llvm \
      -B build \
      -G Ninja \
      -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
      -DLLVM_ENABLE_ASSERTIONS=ON \
      -DLLVM_TARGETS_TO_BUILD="X86;AArch64;RISCV" \
      -DCIRCT_DIALECTS="Arc;Calyx;Comb;DC;ESI;Emit;FIRRTL;FSM;HW;HWArith;Handshake;Interop;Kanagawa;LLHD;LTL;MSFT;Moore;OM;Pipeline;RTG;SV;Seq;Sim;Synth;SystemC;Verif" \
      -DCIRCT_FRONTENDS="PyCDE" \
      -DLLVM_ENABLE_PROJECTS="mlir" \
      -DMLIR_ENABLE_BINDINGS_PYTHON=ON && \
    \
    echo "-----------------------------------------------------" && \
    echo "✅ CIRCT development environment is ready!" && \
    echo "" && \
    echo "To build a specific part (e.g., Comb dialect tests):" && \
    echo "  cd build" && \
    echo "  ninja check-circt-dialect-comb" && \
    echo "-----------------------------------------------------" \
  '
